title: Qaid khane may ye
body:
qaid khane mein ye kehti thi sakina bhai
zulm aada ne kiya hum pa ye kaisa bhai
qaid khane mein ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
chod kar humko madine jo chale jaaoge
ghut ke reh jayegi har ek tamanna bhai
qaid khane mein ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
maut aajaye agar shaam ke zindan mein hamein
dafn karna inhi kapdon mein janaza bhai
qaid khane mein ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab jagana nahi hum jaate hai sone ke liye
maut ne aa ke bichaya hai bichona bhai
qaid khane mein ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai yahan maut ki aagosh mein so jaungi
sab madine mein mera dekhenge rasta bhai
qaid khane mein ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab se choda hai madine ka bhara ghar hum ne
khaak mein mil gayi har ek tamanna bhai
qaid khane mein ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
khairiyat meri madine ke jo bache pooche
mujh pa kya guzri unhe kuch na batana bhai
qaid khane mein ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab madine se palat kar kabhi shaam aana ho
saath baaji ko meri qabr pe laana bhai
qaid khane mein ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum ko pani ke liye bhej ke sharminda thi
karbala jaa ke chacha jaan se kehna bhai
qaid khane mein ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehke ishrat ye sakina ne kiya sab ko salaam
hum ko lene ke liye aagaye baba bhai
qaid khane mein ye...
author: Ishrat Lakhnavi
